articles.title: A New Battery Made from Salt? It Could Power Cars One Day!
articles.summary: Imagine a battery that uses cheap, common salt instead of expensive lithium. Chinese scientists made one that's almost as good as Tesla's best. It still needs work for cold weather, but it could make electric cars cheaper.

articles.title: Why Are Lakes Turning Brown? It's Changing Who Lives Underwater!
articles.summary: Lakes across North America and Europe are getting darker, like tea. This makes it hard for some fish to see and catch food. Trout and bass are disappearing, but pike and walleye are loving it. Here's why — and what it means for your next fishing trip.

articles.title: A Tiny Protein in Your Brain Might Stop Alzheimer's — Here's How
articles.summary: Scientists found a brain protein called tubulin that keeps two troublemaker proteins from clumping up. Those clumps cause Alzheimer's and Parkinson's. Tubulin gives them a job to do instead, like a teacher keeping kids busy so they don't cause trouble.
